changes: Extracted ID-ordered vocabulary; appended declared blank ID8192. No learned weights. UTF-8 table generation replaces metaspace only and omits configured special IDs.
configured_special_ids_note: UNK0, PAD2, configured EOS3, added blank8192; other control-looking pieces are retained as in the pinned tokenizer configuration, rather than Fermion CUDA broad filtering.
nonblank_zero_duration: remain on frame, commit predictor/cache per Transformers input token semantics; no ten-symbol forced advance
termination: encoder valid length exhausted or configured EOS3; step-budget exhaustion is incomplete/error, never success
max_steps_default: 10 * stored_encoder_frames - 1, corresponding to Transformers max_length including initial blank
text_layout: 32-byte UTF-8 scatter/gather slots plus device byte lengths; ordinary output I/O may coalesce segments, with no token mapping, whitespace conversion or model computation on host
